messages.subject: Space-time model type I crashes
parts:
Dear all, 

I am running a space-time logistic regression based on 1 million individuals observed over 9 years, nested within 16,500 areas.

the dataset has 9 million rows, 1 million rows per year.

I have created the id variables as follows:

id.area: the id for area, ranging from 1 to 16,500
id.year: the id for year, ranging from 1 to 9
id.area.year: the id for the combination of area and year, rangin from 1 to 148,500 (16,500 area ids multiplied with the 9 ids for year, calculated by: id.area X id.year)

the code is following:



type_I <- inla(x ~  1 + age + sex_male + c+ d + e + f+ 
                 g + h + 
                 f(id.area, model = "bym", graph = "D:/INLA/bes") + 
                 f(id.year, model ="rw2") + 
                 f(id.year2, model ="iid") + 
                 f(id.area.year, model ="iid"),  
               family = "binomial",  control.family = list(link = "logit"), data=data, control.compute = list(dic=T, openmp.strategy = "huge"),
               control.inla = list(strategy = "gaussian", int.strategy = "eb", reordering = "amdc"), verbose = T)

summary(type_I)

While type 2, 3 and 4  run perfectly fine, type 1 interaction crashes with the following error. Is there anything coded wrong, or is it normal that some models just dont work for specific datasets?

Many thanks in advance. 

Best, Boris
